title: Japanese Teriyaki Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Japanese-inspired stir fry recipe featuring American sausage and a sweet teriyaki sauce.
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it starts to caramelize, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the American sausage and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the flaky and stir-fry until combined, about 2-3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, umami, and a pinch of sugar.
Pour the teriyaki sauce over the stir-fry and cook for another minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds, if desired.
